connector.name: github-twin
connector.registryDescription: Personal RAG over your GitHub history (commits, code, reviews), served to Claude Code over MCP.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package github-twin. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the christopherdavenport account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: GITHUB_TOKEN
env.description: GitHub personal access token. Optional: github-twin can also pick the token up from `gh auth token` or from its own OAuth device-flow login (`gt auth login`).

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Enables the Claude backend for `gt summarize`, `gt distill`, and `gt eval`. Defaults to local Ollama when unset.

env.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
env.description: Optional. Enables the Gemini backend for embedding and the LLM seam. Vertex AI ADC via `GT_GEMINI_PROJECT` is also supported.

env.name: GT_PATHS__DATA_DIR
env.description: Optional. Override the on-disk data directory holding the SQLite index, embeddings, and cached GitHub responses. Defaults to `$XDG_DATA_HOME/github-twin`.
